headline: 3-0 lead: Canada dominates Qatar in first half
summary: Jonathan David scores twice as Canada takes a commanding lead, while Qatar is reduced to 10 men after a red card.
details: Canada took a commanding 3-0 lead over Qatar by the end of the first half, with Jonathan David netting two goals and Cyle Larin adding another.
The scoring began in the 16th minute when Cyle Larin found the back of the net, continuing his scoring streak from the previous match against Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Jonathan David then doubled the lead in the 29th minute with a brilliant goal, after an initial shot was parried by Qatari goalkeeper Mahmoud Abu Nada.
Qatar's situation worsened in the 33rd minute when Homam Ahmed received a red card for fouling Canadian forward Teahjus Buchanan inside the box.
The first half concluded with Jonathan David scoring his second goal and the team's third in stoppage time, leaving Qatar to play with 10 men.
caption:
A dominant first half! Canada leads 3-0 against Qatar with Jonathan David scoring twice.

Canada took a commanding 3-0 lead over Qatar by the end of the first half, with Jonathan David netting two goals and Cyle Larin adding another.

The scoring began in the 16th minute when Cyle Larin found the back of the net, continuing his scoring streak from the previous match against Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Jonathan David then doubled the lead in the 29th minute with a brilliant goal, after an initial shot was parried by Qatari goalkeeper Mahmoud Abu Nada.

Qatar's situation worsened in the 33rd minute when Homam Ahmed received a red card for fouling Canadian forward Teahjus Buchanan inside the box.

The first half concluded with Jonathan David scoring his second goal and the team's third in stoppage time, leaving Qatar to play with 10 men.

headline_marked: Family says [[Messi's father is recovering]] from health issue
headline: Family says Messi's father is recovering from health issue
summary: Jorge Messi is reportedly 'evolving favourably' after speculation grew following Lionel Messi's emotional reaction during a World Cup match.
details: Lionel Messi's father, Jorge Messi, is recovering from a health issue and is 'evolving favourably', according to a statement released by the family on Thursday.

The news comes after intense speculation regarding Jorge's health. This followed a moment where Lionel Messi wiped away tears with his shirt after scoring Argentina's first goal against Algeria at the World Cup.
At the time, Messi stated he was crying for personal reasons not connected to the sport and mentioned he had been going through difficult days.
The family's statement clarified that Jorge is currently 'under medical follow-up' and requested privacy from the media.
They further emphasized that the health and tranquility of an individual should not be the subject of irresponsible media speculation.
A source close to the family told Reuters that Jorge Messi is in a delicate state in a hospital in Argentina.
caption:
Lionel Messi's father is recovering from a health issue after weeks of speculation.

Lionel Messi's father, Jorge Messi, is recovering from a health issue and is 'evolving favourably', according to a statement released by the family on Thursday.

The news comes after intense speculation regarding Jorge's health. This followed a moment where Lionel Messi wiped away tears with his shirt after scoring Argentina's first goal against Algeria at the World Cup.

At the time, Messi stated he was crying for personal reasons not connected to the sport and mentioned he had been going through difficult days.

The family's statement clarified that Jorge is currently 'under medical follow-up' and requested privacy from the media.

They further emphasized that the health and tranquility of an individual should not be the subject of irresponsible media speculation.

A source close to the family told Reuters that Jorge Messi is in a delicate state in a hospital in Argentina.
